description: A stale tab shows 'Add webhook' (or an old token block as valid) after another tab changed things. Clicking Add webhook there silently replaces the other tab's token, and the other tab keeps displaying its dead token as Active.
expected: The stale dialog refreshes or warns 'A webhook already exists; adding a new one replaces it.'
actual: No warning. Old tab shows the revoked token as valid with the same Created time (token A 200, token B 401 in my check).
suggested_fix: Re-read the webhook state when the dialog gets focus or before add; if one exists, switch to the Replace wording and warn.
